name: COTTONWOOD POINT

source.ridbExport: RIDB full export (CSV), Recreation.gov, CC BY 4.0

roadPick.why: The usual source, and its roads fit the sites as well as any

traced.note: Replaces the source's roads, which drew farm tracks in the field and almost nothing in the campground. Traced every road on the six points from the photo: the west loop and its lanes, the lane past 049 to 058, the middle point's road past 038 to 048, the loop round 001 to 037 and its lanes past 005 to 029, the loop and oval past 095 to 117, the lane past 118 to 130, and the two stems past 131 to 165 with the access roads. Left out: the short pull-ins to each site, the lane through the trees between the road and 068 (its north stub and its south part are drawn unjoined), and the paths across the grass.
